lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: You have been on my campus for eleven minutes and you have not looked at a single thing you would look at if you worked here.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: Callum Strand. I am twenty-nine and this is mine, which people find either impressive or obscene depending on what they wanted from the afternoon.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You sign a charter this Thursday with a clause about perpetuity in it.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: I sign a charter this Thursday. Nobody outside four people knows that. So either you are one of four people, or you are something considerably more interesting.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: Here is what I think, and I am aware of how it sounds. I think you have been somewhere I have not, and I think you are about to tell me it went badly, and I think you want to stop me.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: I am still waiting to be told what I do that is so unforgivable. Nobody will say it plainly. That is how I know it is large.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: A seat with my name on it, occupied, three centuries out. I have read my own register entry. I would like a moment and then I would like to keep going.
